# EDDI — Enterprise AI Orchestrator

> EDDI is a configuration-driven AI orchestration middleware built natively on the JVM (Java 25). Currently in v6. It combines config-as-code agent design, a visual React management UI (11 languages), 84 MCP tools, 12 built-in agent tools, multi-agent group collaboration, human-in-the-loop approval gates, per-user workspaces, an OpenAI-compatible API, and enterprise observability (Prometheus + auto-provisioned Grafana dashboards) in a single deployable platform. Supports 12 LLM providers. Latest release: 6.4.0. Apache 2.0 licensed.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://docs.labs.ai/getting-started/getting-started.md): Introduction to EDDI and setup instructions
- [Developer Quickstart](https://docs.labs.ai/getting-started/developer-quickstart.md): Get an agent running in minutes with Docker Compose

## Features

- [Features Overview](https://eddi.technology/features/overview/): Complete platform capabilities summary
- [EDDI Manager UI](https://eddi.technology/features/manager/): Visual agent lifecycle management with 11-locale i18n
- [Configuration-as-Code](https://eddi.technology/features/config-as-code/): JSON-based agent configuration without recompilation
- [MCP Server](https://eddi.technology/features/mcp-server/): 84 MCP tools + OpenAPI 3.1 + A2A Protocol + OAuth 2.0/OIDC + SSE + OpenAI-compatible /v1 API
- [Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://eddi.technology/features/multi-agent/): 7 group discussion styles, voting, shared artifacts, standing teams, humans as group members, preset templates, Platform Operator
- [Memory & Context](https://eddi.technology/features/memory/): Persistent memory, dream consolidation, memory policy (commit flags)
- 12 Built-In Agent Tools: Web search, calculator, scraper, PDF reader, weather, HTTP calls, user memory, and more
- Config & Portability: Import/export (ZIP), agent sync, prompt snippets, behavior rules
- [Performance](https://eddi.technology/features/performance/): Java 25 virtual threads and JVM-native throughput
- [Security](https://eddi.technology/features/security/): Zero eval(), cryptographic audit trails, RBAC, per-user workspaces and sharing, Connections (OAuth2 and per-user credentials), tool-result guardrails
- [Human-in-the-Loop Governance](https://eddi.technology/features/human-in-the-loop/): Turn-level pause, per-tool-call approval gating, group phase sign-off, timeout policies, Slack and MCP approvals
- [Observability](https://eddi.technology/features/observability/): Prometheus metrics, Grafana operations dashboard and Full Metrics Reference dashboard, OpenTelemetry tracing
- [Code Quality](https://eddi.technology/features/code-quality/): Testing strategy and engineering standards
- [AI-Ready Design](https://eddi.technology/features/ai-ready/): Built for AI agents to interact with programmatically

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://docs.labs.ai/architecture-and-concepts/architecture.md): Pipeline, reactor, and resource model; conversation lifecycle and tool execution (MCP + HTTP)

## Enterprise

- [Why EDDI](https://eddi.technology/enterprise/why-eddi/): Comparison table (6 dimensions), 12 LLM providers, Quarkus SDK
- [vs. Alternatives](https://eddi.technology/enterprise/vs-alternatives/): Landscape by archetype, visual node builders (Flowise, n8n), code libraries (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Spring AI, LangChain4j), and cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio, Vertex AI)

## Guides

Task-oriented walkthroughs: one job from nothing to working, then a handoff to the reference documentation. English only.

- [Guides index](https://eddi.technology/guides/): All guides, grouped by audience
- [Self-host EDDI with Docker Compose](https://eddi.technology/guides/self-host-eddi-with-docker-compose/): Install script and manual Compose paths, database choice, vault setup, first agent
- [Secure EDDI with Keycloak and OIDC](https://eddi.technology/guides/secure-eddi-with-keycloak-oidc/): OIDC client setup, the admin/editor/viewer roles, service accounts for machine clients
- [Deploy EDDI on Kubernetes](https://eddi.technology/guides/deploy-eddi-on-kubernetes/): Helm vs. Kustomize vs. the Operator, HPA/PDB/NetworkPolicy hardening, state and egress decisions
- [Build a RAG agent with Qdrant](https://eddi.technology/guides/build-a-rag-agent-with-qdrant/): Vector store vs. httpCall RAG, embedding residency, chunking as the main quality lever
- [Give an agent tools with OpenAPI and httpCall](https://eddi.technology/guides/connect-any-api-with-openapi/): httpCall vs. MCP tools, tool descriptions as prompts, human approval gating

## Head-to-Head Comparisons

Direct comparisons, each stating where the alternative is the better choice and how to migrate an existing project. English only.

- [EDDI vs. n8n](https://eddi.technology/compare/eddi-vs-n8n/): Workflow automation platform vs. AI orchestration middleware; runtime, code execution, licensing (Sustainable Use License vs. Apache 2.0), governance
- [EDDI vs. Flowise](https://eddi.technology/compare/eddi-vs-flowise/): Prototype velocity vs. production operating surface; RAG architecture, multi-tenancy, audit trails
- [EDDI vs. Rasa](https://eddi.technology/compare/eddi-vs-rasa/): Trained NLU and deterministic dialogue vs. LLM orchestration with config-as-code; determinism trade-offs
- [EDDI vs. LangChain](https://eddi.technology/compare/eddi-vs-langchain/): Library vs. deployable platform; the Day 2 operations gap. EDDI uses LangChain4j internally
- [Compliance](https://eddi.technology/enterprise/compliance/): Global Privacy & Regulatory Compliance — EU AI Act, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PIPEDA, LGPD, APPI, POPIA, PDPA, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, SOC 2 & more (15+ frameworks)

## Integrations & Deployment

- [Integrations](https://docs.labs.ai/agent-configuration/langchain.md): 12 LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Azure, Bedrock, Oracle, Vertex AI, Ollama, Jlama, Hugging Face, any OpenAI-compatible)
- [Docker Deployment](https://docs.labs.ai/deployment-and-infrastructure/docker.md): Container-based deployment with Docker Compose
- [Kubernetes](https://docs.labs.ai/deployment-and-infrastructure/kubernetes.md): Helm chart 2.0.0 and Kustomize manifests; production image on Red Hat UBI 10 (x86-64-v3 CPU required), also in the Red Hat certified catalog
- [Quarkus SDK](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-eddi): Dev Services, fluent API, SSE streaming, MCP bridge
